tests.input: (lambda th, c: (lambda L, t: (lambda r: (r[3], r[6]))((L.acquire(timeout=1), None, t.start(), (t.join(0.3), t.is_alive())[1], L.release(), t.join(2), c.value)))(next(v for v in list(vars(c).values()) if hasattr(v, 'acquire') and hasattr(v, 'release')), th.Thread(target=c.increment)))(__import__('threading'), Counter())

tests.description: a new counter starts at zero
the lock is released after an increment
tests.input: (lambda c: (c.increment(), (lambda L: (L.acquire(False), L.release())[0])(next(v for v in list(vars(c).values()) if hasattr(v, 'acquire') and hasattr(v, 'release'))))[-1])(Counter())
(lambda a, b: (a.increment(), a.increment(), b.increment(), (a.value, b.value))[-1])(Counter(), Counter())

mutants.note_en: Creates a new lock on every call, so threads never wait for each other.
